title: Pablo Exclusive Strawberry Lychee Nicotine  Pouches - 30mg / Pouch
description: Pablo Strawberry Lychee Nicotine Pouches offer a bold and distinctive flavour, combining the sweetness of ripe Strawberry with the tropical twist of Lychee. This fruity pairing delivers a vibrant taste profile designed to appeal to those who enjoy sweet and exotic blends. With a high-strength 30mg per pouch nicotine dose per pouch, Pablo delivers a strong, fast-acting nicotine experience ideal for those with a higher tolerance. The slim pouches are completely tobacco-free and sit discreetly under the lip, providing a clean, vapourless alternative to smoking or vaping. Each can includes 20 slim-format pouches and features a sleek, travel-friendly design for convenient use on the go. How to Use: 1 Place a pouch between your upper lip and gum for a consistent nicotine release for up to 60min 2 Place the used pouch in the designated top compartment of the pack. 3 Dispose of the pouch. PLEASE DO NOT CHEW OR SWALLOW POUCH Please Note: These nicotine pouches are 30mg of nicotine per pouch.
